title: Unit Event — Parallel Harmonies

meta.Outline: Leo/need is finally going to start writing its debut song! However, Mr. Shindo has a request: that Saki and Ichika compose it together. The pair are determined to make it a great song, but things don't go so smoothly...

rows.Line: Solis Records

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line:
Shindo is currently in a meeting.
I'll have him come over once it's finished. I ask that you have a seat and wait patiently in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, thank you very much.
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
This is so exciting!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Aren't you a little too giddy?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But he said he wanted to talk to all of us. Doesn't that mean it's something important?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
True.
We have only been talking to each other through email and video meetings lately.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Something important...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What if there's been a new development with regards to our debut?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah!
So far, all we know is the date he told us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What else could it be...? Maybe we get to perform in that festival?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Both are very exciting prospects.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess you have a point.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait for Mr. Shindo to get here.
Thank you for coming all this way today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sounds like Mr. Shindo's finished with his other meeting.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
That means he should be here soon.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Huh...?
Please give them my regards. We have high hopes for them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why does that person seem so familiar...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Oh, you're all here.
Perfect. Allow me to introduce you.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: This is Mr. Shimizu, one of the producers for Starry Music...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Starry Music...?
As in THE Starry Music...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I knew I'd seen you somewhere before...

rows.Speaker: Shimizu
rows.Line:
Oh, you must be Leo/need!
Hello, my name is Shimizu.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-It's nice to meet you as well.
We're Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Shiho, Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: Nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Shimizu
rows.Line: Yes, it's nice to finally meet all of you.

rows.Speaker: Shimizu
rows.Line: I heard that you're going to be playing in Jam Fest. I couldn't believe it when I heard you're already slated to perform in it before making your debut.

rows.Speaker: Shimizu
rows.Line: I wish you all the best of luck.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, we plan to do our very best!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, huh...?
We get to play in that festival?!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, we'll discuss that in a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Shimizu
rows.Line:
Haha. Sorry, Shindo.
I didn't mean to spill the beans like that.

rows.Speaker: Shimizu
rows.Line:
But we have very high hopes for you.
After all, you were handpicked by Shindo here.

rows.Speaker: Shimizu
rows.Line: And he's been a huge help so far.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
I appreciate the compliment.
And I'm definitely happy about receiving such a big opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Shimizu
rows.Line: Haha. Call it a win-win.

rows.Speaker: Shimizu
rows.Line:
Oh, look at the time. I need to get going...
Again, everyone, good luck!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Thank you very much!
se_walk_men_002_2

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-That was kind of a surprise...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I mean, this is a huge company we're talking about...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
More importantly, Mr. Shindo!
We really get to play at that festival?!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Ah, yes. We came to a decision just the other day during an internal meeting.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: On one hand, there is still quite a lot you need to work on as a band.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But on the other, Ms. Mochizuki's rapid growth over such a short period coupled with your incredible sound made us believe that you'll be ready by the day of.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You have plenty of time until Jam Fest, so my hope is that you'll be able to use that time to gain more experience and make improvements.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right...!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We did it, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We did...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: There's also another important matter I need to discuss with you all today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Something else...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I'd like to start working on Leo/need's debut single.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our debut single?!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Yes.
Some marketing decisions were also made during the meeting I just mentioned, meaning it's now time to take this step.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see...
Well, we are going to need a single if we're going to make our debut.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Right!
And we gotta make it a good one!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: However, I'd like to make an additional request regarding that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: An additional request...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I'd like for you two to write it together, Ms. Tenma, Ms. Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...
I'll write the lyrics and Saki will come up with the music like always...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Not quite...
I'm talking about you two doing both of those things together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: What...?
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That was a good meeting.
We got to hear quite a lot of news today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I was wondering which we'd get to hear about, our debut or that festival. I can't believe we got to hear about both!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me neither. Especially when we heard what we'll be doing for our debut single...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: He really wants you and me to write it together, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You want Saki and Ichika to write it together...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Together...? Why is that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Saki always handles the music...
So, wouldn't it be better to leave that in her hands...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, I considered that option.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: The public gets its first impression of a band through its debut single. Which is why I thought about having you go with the process you've employed until now.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But I decided against that. Instead of business as usual, I want you all to show everyone what Leo/need is like after you've reached the next level.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After we've reached the next level...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can you elaborate a little further...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: As things currently stand, Leo/need's debut takes first priority over everything else at this company for this part of the fiscal year.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: First priority...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: We plan to inject all our resources into coming up with the best marketing campaign for your band.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Which is why Mr. Shimizu from Starry Music, our parent company, was here. To discuss that very matter.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: In return for receiving a share of the distribution rights to Leo/need's debut single, they've agreed to help us with your marketing campaign.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, and Mr. Shimizu also holds you in high regard.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Starry Music will be giving you its spot on the digital billboards, as well as funding our ad campaigns centered around social media.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Billboards...! That means...
This is like a super duper huge deal...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, it is.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: To be honest, I wasn't expecting them to come up with so much money for us.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But if things go well, your song is going to reach a lot of ears.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: In other words, you'll become household names overnight.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Normally, we'd give a band more time to flesh out their music. And you ladies are still just getting on your feet.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: My original plan was to begin with having you become more experienced by playing shows and releasing more songs. Then, I would've started a big marketing campaign.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But between the decisions that were made during our meeting the other day and Starry Music agreeing to join us in this endeavor...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I came to believe that now is Leo/need's chance to take on a big challenge such as this.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: The music you've produced up until now has been excellent.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
But I believe you can still go higher.
I want to see Leo/need produce a song that can move the hearts of even more people.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I believe Ms. Tenma and Ms. Hoshino will be able to achieve that by putting their individual talents together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me and Ichi...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Your songs have this warmth to them, Ms. Tenma. It's like you're able to show the listener real empathy.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Your songs, Ms. Hoshino, are a little rough around the edges, but they have this charm to them because of how you always try to make your feelings crystal clear.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Which is where this idea comes from.
If Leo/need is able to join these two pieces in producing music, then I feel that your band is going to sound like it's taken another step forward.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: By doing so, I believe you'll be able to reach more people. In other words, Leo/need's music will be on a whole new level.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Which will surely make your debut single an enormous success.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our music...? The next level...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I'll look forward to hearing what you come up with.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The next level...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Can we really accomplish that...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We'll be fine, Ichi!
This is us we're talking about!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. I also believe you two will do just fine.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So do I, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Compared to Ichika, aren't you being a little too optimistic about this, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. No way!
Ichi and I've got this!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Does that mean you already know what you wanna do?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... Not exactly...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I feel like Ichi and I are unstoppable when we're together!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And it's not like Mr. Shindo would tell us to do this if he didn't think we could handle it, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, true...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I agree. You and I should do just fine, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Just wait, Shiho, Hona!
We're gonna write the best debut single ever!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, we're counting on you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Good luck.
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, Ichi!
Let's get cracking on our song!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. But I still don't know how we're actually going to write a song together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah... Mr. Shindo said that we should, but nothing about how, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I don't know what we're supposed to do either, but let's just do what we can for now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why don't we first decide what we want it to be about? Then we can come up with a melody for it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! What do we want it to be about...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
So that's why Ichika and Saki are writing a song together.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Imagine what Leo/need's gonna be like when they reach the next level...! I can't wait to see!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What do you think their song is going to be like...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm very much looking forward to hearing it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, let's give them some space by practicing over there.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay!
I know! Why don't we have ourselves a little jam session?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure. I kinda want to see how far I can push you, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Likewise.
I did train quite a lot, remember?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Pretty big talk.
Anyway, shall we?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Good luck, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Even if we do manage to reach the next level as Leo/need, it'll still be important for us to be ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! So, if we want it to be an expression of our past and future selves... I think we should come up with a cheerful melody.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I like that.
What about a riff like this?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This sounds like us...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But not really next level...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... Then, let's give it some more edge! What if we threw in some chord progressions that other people have been using a lot?

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: Hmmm...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Maybe a little too eccentric...
Or rather, so pop that it doesn't really sound like a Leo/need song anymore.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm... This is so hard...
No, let's give it another try!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, it's already this late...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, look at the time!
I'm gonna get an earful if I don't get home soon...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we weren't able to come up with any good ideas for our song...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... This is so hard. What's next-level Leo/need supposed to sound like? How do we come up with a song that reflects that...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're back, you two.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Hona! Shiho, you too...?
Are you two done with practice?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, we just found a good place to stop.
How'd things go, you two?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not all that well, to tell you the truth.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
We tried coming up with a theme and a melody like usual, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, what if you made some changes to your process?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This other band I know told me one time that they change how they write songs whenever they hit a block.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, someone who usually starts with the melody might come up with the chord progression first instead.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, it might be good to change things up if the way we're used to doesn't work!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We were working on the melody for it just now, so let's start with some chord progressions next time...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What if we each came up with some chord progressions and tried building a melody off of what the other person wrote?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I feel like that'll be a lot easier than trying to discuss things each time. In theory, we should be able to express who we each are while also clearing a path to the goal.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I like that idea...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it's interesting how chord progressions and melodies feel drastically different depending on who comes up with them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, doesn't that mean you'll end up with two different songs in the end?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Good point...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, what if we pick one somewhere along the way and focus on that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that should work!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, we'll try this new method starting tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I know! Let's make coming up with chord progressions our homework, and have a listening party the next time we meet...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Huh, why not?
Sounds like it'd be interesting.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
I'm gonna come up with some really good ones!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll need to do my best to match your enthusiasm.
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which chords should I use for this...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ones that reflect me.
Ones that show Leo/need on the next level...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... That's really hard...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Saki, can I come in?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Tsukasa!
Sure, what's up?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I've been sent to let you know that dinner's ready.
Hm? Were you working on a song just now...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was! It's gonna be our debut single!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Also, guess what?!
Ichi and I are writing it together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, a collaborative effort!
That sounds like quite a bit of fun!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But is everything okay...?
Is it giving you some trouble...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! How did you know?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You were groaning so loudly that I could hear you from outside your room. You even exclaimed, “What do I do? This is so hard!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-You heard me...?
Now I'm really embarrassed...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But you're right...
It hasn't been going very smoothly...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, Saki.
What if you held a songwriting camp?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A songwriting camp?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. I still remember brainstorming the night away in our hotel room back when we were doing those ambassadorial performances. We came up with some wonderful ideas!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I think writing your song somewhere different and more relaxing than usual should help you come up with some new ideas.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Remember how Mom and Dad are taking that trip this weekend? Why don't you invite Ichika and spend some time together working on your song?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! A-Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course. And if Ichika's coming, then I'll plan a training camp dedicated to acting research.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, you two should be able to focus on writing your song without any distractions.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (If Ichi and I hold our own songwriting camp, then I'm sure we'll come up with some amazing ideas...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Hehe. And write a great song! All thanks to Tsukasa!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (He and everyone else are giving us whatever support they can, so we've gotta come up with the best debut single ever!)
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Welcome, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Pardon the intrusion.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Come on in♪
Hehe. I'm so happy about you staying over.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm a little excited since I've never done a songwriting camp before.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too! It's too bad that Shiho and Hona can't come...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we just gotta do our best to knock their socks off by writing an amazing song!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do that!
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now, let's begin our inaugural songwriting camp♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. You're making it sound so extravagant. It's just the two of us, remember?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, we gotta hype ourselves up.
Anyway, let's start listening to the chord progressions we each came up with!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay, Ichi!
I sent my ideas over to your phone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks.
I'll send you mine now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is so cool!
I can't wait to hear what you came up with.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I spent a lot of time coming up with mine, so hurry! You gotta listen to them!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright. Then, why don't we start by listening to each other's stuff?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa... Ichi, this is so good!
They're so straightforward and powerful...
I bet we can turn this into a really amazing song!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Y-You think so?
But I'm glad you're saying that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My hope for this song is that it'll help remind everyone about those who matter most to them and reinforce those bonds.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Really...?!
I like it since it's got you written all over it, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank goodness...! I liked yours a lot too, Saki. It's really cheerful, but a little sad at times.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. So, mine's about being able to move forward regardless of any doubt or pain you might be feeling.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Which is a nice reflection of your personality.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Now I really want to come up with a melody for this song...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too! So, let's get started!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay.
But being in the same room like this might make things a bit awkward...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So, can I use the living room?
I feel like we're going to distract each other if we're sitting right next to each other like this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
That's too bad since you went to the trouble of coming over, but I guess we don't have a choice...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, let's meet back up once we've both finished our songs!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay.
See you in a bit.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
See you!
And let's do our best, Ichi♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright...!
I've gotta do my best to come up with a really great melody!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Hehe. This chord progression sounds so much like something Ichi would come up with...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (A song to remind people about who matters most to them, and those bonds, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Based on my own feelings and this chord progression...)
Two hours later

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think it's turning out pretty well!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's a little rough around the edges, but the basic idea's there. I can show it to Ichi once I brush it up just a...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Who could that be? Did we get a delivery?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Coming!

rows.Speaker: Saki

Oh, Ichi!

rows.Line:
I didn't know that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks so much!

rows.Line: Oh, stop.

rows.Line: But...

rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Line:

rows.Line: I was looking for something a little more positive since it's supposed to be a straightforward expression of my feelings...

rows.Line: Straightforward...

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Cool!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Saki? Uhh...

rows.Line: Yeah, it's just...

rows.Line: It's too pop compared to what I imagined.

rows.Line: Too pop...?

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
Empathy, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry I misunderstood what you were going for, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay! I'll be down in the living room.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, see you in a bit!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is so hard...
I was so sure I got it right...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But I need to come up with a better melody...!
Because this song means a lot to us... To Leo/need...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I gotta take what Ichi wanted and...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, this still doesn't feel quite right...

rows.Line: The melody sounds a lot more cheerful now, and I like how the tempo really picks up during the bridge, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Line: So, can you tell me what specifically doesn't feel right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Line: I guess how it still feels kind of sad. I can't seem to get that out of my head...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:

rows.Line:
I know...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:

rows.Line: I like how quick the tempo is, but this song's not supposed to be all that cheerful...

rows.Line: But won't that take away from your theme of trying to move forward?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sorry, it's just...

rows.Line: I'm doing my best not to make it sound so cheerful, like you said...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I guess I'm just not getting it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry, I'm trying to understand what you want this song to be about, but I'm sort of not sure what I'm doing wrong anymore...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi...

rows.Line: It's just, I believe this is the best way to get your message across, you know...?

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I don't understand...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (No matter how many times we try, we can't seem to get on the same page...)

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:

rows.Line: Yeah, I do...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Am I not explaining things right...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I mean, Ichi knows that pain. She's suffered like we all did.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (So why...?)

rows.Line: Alright, for example... What if we went with this kind of sound instead?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's not a big change from what you have now, but just a little darker...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Saki.

rows.Line: But given the overarching theme, this just isn't going to work.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, are you saying...?

rows.Line: A melody I came up with isn't going to work?

rows.Speaker: Ichika

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's just... Even if we do go with your idea, I don't think it's going to turn out well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sorry, I didn't mean to say that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's just... Nothing's really felt right to me either, you know?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I tried and tried to make mine sound the way you want, Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it never feels like it's getting better.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This is a lot harder than I realized it would be...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry, I'm going to go buy something to drink.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Why is nothing going right...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I was so sure that Ichi and I would be able to write an amazing song together...)

rows.Line: But if this keeps up, we might not even be able to finish it, let alone reach the next level...

rows.Line: (What do we do...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But I don't know if I can write a next-level Leo/need song all on my own...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I don't want things to end this way...

rows.Line: I... I also think that it's going to be hard to get our feelings to mesh together coherently.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I think I can do what Miku and the others just did. If I listen better and keep my mind more open, then I believe we'll succeed...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm going to take in everything you've been talking about. What kind of song you want it to be, and what kind of sound you want to achieve. I'll build from there...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: B-But...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What about how you feel...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's not like I'm going to completely sweep my own feelings off to the side. However, I do believe this is our best option for success right now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I want to do what I can to make sure our listeners hear your message, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, I want to be able to do what Miku and the others just did.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They've been there to listen this whole time. They've given me so much...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Whenever I was writing lyrics or working on a song, they were always willing to lend an ear.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which resulted in me being able to turn my feelings into music... I realize that now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So, next...
I want to help make your music come to life.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Like Miku and the others did with me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's make the most amazing song ever...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you all so much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You helped us make an important realization.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Now, we should be able to write a great song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We really appreciate it, since this is sort of our only way of helping you girls.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Your only way...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Our only way of helping is by assisting in turning your feelings into music.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We can't write our own songs like you can, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We can only listen to your thoughts and produce music based on that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We always wish we could do more to help...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, I couldn't be happier that we were able to lend you both a hand like this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Good luck, you two.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We'll be looking forward to you producing the best song ever.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks!
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We're gonna write the best song ever...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Ichi said that she'd turn my feelings into music.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (To make sure Leo/need's debut single turns out amazing...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (And I don't want to let her down!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, I've come up with a rough melody!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I'll listen to it now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I like it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
What you said was all there.
It let me know that everything is going to be okay, and how we can all move forward together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?! Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Nod*
But...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, what's up?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What if you took this part of the chorus and added it to the beginning of the song?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The melody for the chorus is really compelling, so I think it'd leave a nice impression if I sang right from the beginning...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This song's about telling the listener they'll be able to move forward despite whatever is bothering them, so I feel like that'd be a good way for this song to start off.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, you could gradually add more instruments to show the listener that they're not alone. That they'll be able to move forward together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Like we did with our band...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right...
Thanks, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, we'll add the chorus to the beginning, and start with just us on keyboard and vocals...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, um... Are we increasing the tempo towards the end of the chorus?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! That'll make it feel like we're running towards our goal together!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, once we have every instrument involved, we could throw in a break to signal the start of the next part. How does that sound...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If we start playing again with just the right timing, it should provide the listener with a nice sense of togetherness.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I really like that idea...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In that case, the following verse should try to maintain that momentum while telling the next part of the story.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How do you want to do that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I guess this part will be about pain or doubt... But with the sense that you need to start moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, we might want to keep it a bit subdued like it already is...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. This verse really hits home when I think about everything we went through...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can almost feel this melody wrapping its arms around me when I look back on what happened...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know. What if we placed more of an emphasis on moving forward one step at a time?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: One step at a time...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, we could throw in some triplets.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We could even have Shiho sing for this part, and Hona here!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah! Then it'd feel like we're each taking the next step!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe! Alright, let's do that!
Next, we have...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (This is the opposite of earlier. We can't stop coming up with good ideas now...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Is this because Ichi decided to do what Miku and the others did? She really understands how I feel now...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We can do it now.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We have to succeed...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Ichi, Miku and everyone are giving me all the help they can!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I have to make this the best song ever!)
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's done...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It finally is...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Your message about moving forward despite any pain or doubt is so clear...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which makes me really glad...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...! And I couldn't have done it without you, Ichi. Thanks for all your help!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I didn't do anything...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We have Miku and the others to thank for this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Because Miku and MEIKO...
Everyone in SEKAI helped make this song a reality.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. This is so cool.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We first started our band so that we could play Miku songs together, and we really owe her and the others a lot.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now, on top of that, they helped us produce an amazing debut single...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which sorta means we never would've been able to get this far without our VIRTUAL SINGER friends.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree completely...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right?! Oh...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, you've been posting Miku versions of our songs online, right...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Yeah, I have...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, can you post this one too?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want lots and lots of people to hear it. Also, I wanna hear what it sounds like when Miku and the others sing it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They made this song possible, so I want to give it the respect it deserves!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, let's ask Mr. Shindo about this when we have him listen to it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. However, there is a real possibility that we'll be told this song isn't good enough...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No way!
I mean, this is our best song yet♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho and Hona also need to listen to it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's make a song that properly reflects how we both feel someday, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We went with my feeling this time, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I wanna make a song about the both of us someday. Even if we can't agree on everything...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, let's pinky swear...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Someday, we're going to write a song about us!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!
A few days later
Solis Records

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Interesting...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I was expecting you two to come up with a song where both of your styles and personalities would be there at the forefront...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: That being said, this is still a remarkable song.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Within this kindness... This empathy I'm feeling... There's a subtle but strangely powerful sound. It's like I'm being told that I'm not alone...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You two did an excellent job making those work together. I take it you lead in writing it, Ms. Tenma, with Ms. Hoshino as more of an arranger...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-Yes, that's right... We actually tried to do what you said just now at first, Mr. Shindo, but we couldn't get our feelings to really mesh...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: No, I'm beyond impressed that you were able to come up with this in such a short amount of time...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Well done.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
It doesn't matter how things transpired.
You two worked hard to make this happen, and I believe this is a good representation of what Leo/need's music is going to sound like.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Does that mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Yes, let's go with this song.
I'm sure Mr. Shimizu is also going to enjoy hearing this.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: And above all else... I've got a feeling that this is going to hit home with a lot of people.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That's wonderful to hear...!
Thank you both for all your hard work!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's pretty incredible how you were able to come up with something this good so fast.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
I have Ichi and our “seniors” to thank.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku and the others gave us some advice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ah, I see.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
Mr. Shindo, there's something we'd like to ask you...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We were hoping that we could make a VIRTUAL SINGER version of this song to post online...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's just... We think that it'll help give this song more reach!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Would that be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I see. A VIRTUAL SINGER version...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I like it. Why not...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, as long as you post it after the official Leo/need version has been released. That way, people will know which is the original.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: It'll be a nice way to advertise your band.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: We can discuss when you'll be able to post it at a later date.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Woohoo! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I want lots and lots of people to hear it.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: They will. Very soon.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: However, you'll need to actually record it first. I'll be there for that, so let's all do our best to do this song justice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Record it...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I-It really feels like we're pros now!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm a little nervous...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
You'll get used to it in no time.
Things will go smoothly as long as you relax and play the way you normally do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: He just told you to relax.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. Sorry!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But still... I don't blame you for feeling nervous or anxious. After all, this song means a lot to the both of you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, it is an amazing song...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, thank you both...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to playing it as a band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too...!
